body:
### 🟢 Approval recommended No active review issues are reported for the change restoring configurable model selection in issue-triage automation. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Removes the accidental model pin from GitHub CLI’s issue-triage automation, restoring model selection through repository variables and `gh aw` defaults. **Changes:** - Removes the explicit Copilot model from the workflow source. - Regenerates the lock file with separate triage and security-check model fallback chains, dynamic model reporting, and no pinned-model cost overrides. - Documents model-selection variables and their fallback order. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `docs/​issue-triage.md` | Documents model selection and fallback behavior. | | `.github/​workflows/​issue-triage.md` | Removes the model pin while retaining the Copilot engine. | | `.github/​workflows/​issue-triage.lock.yml` | Updates generated model configuration and reporting to match the unpinned workflow. |
Review effort: Balanced
